meta.title: Devlog: September 20, 2026 - September 27, 2026
meta.description: continued building out the android experience for deadline alerts, app blocking, onboarding, and accessibility.

bullets.text: continued building android deadline alerts, including clearer guidance when system settings may delay or limit them.
continued building android app blocking with app selection, an up-front privacy disclosure, and lock-status messaging.
added guidance for android's restricted-settings step so people can reach accessibility setup with fewer dead ends.
expanded the android onboarding experience with work-time setup, time picking, mascot voice support, and layout and accessibility polish.

summary.text: i spent this week making the android version feel less like a reluctant houseguest. the main flows are taking shape, especially around alerts, blocking, and the many system settings android would prefer users discover by accident.
